info.title: Quire-cli
info.description: Package assets from quire.project.yml and extract immutable asset packages.

commands.name: PASSWORD
commands.description: Derive and save a named publishing key.

options.name: -f
options.description:
Config path for package, diff and history commands.
Default: ./quire.project.yml.

options.name: -root
options.description:
package/diff: base for relative source directories.
Default: config directory; absolute sources keep their paths.

options.name: -tag
options.description: package: candidate name (default: generated).

options.name: -jobs
options.description:
package: override build.jobs; 0 = automatic.
unpackage: workers, 1..256 (default: min(CPU, 8)).

options.name: -key
options.description: Package files: client key; required for signed packages.

options.name: -suffix
options.description: Package files: file extension (default: asset).

options.name: -progress
options.description: Stream structured events for GUI/script integration.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the version number.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: FILE
commands.description: Export a binary client key file.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List fingerprints, names and Base64 client keys.

commands.name: KEYNAME
commands.description: Delete a locally stored key.

commands.name: KEYNAME
commands.description: Print one Base64 client key.
